title: Synthetic empty-input handling
body:
## Summary
Return an empty result when parsing an empty string, preserving integer parsing for other inputs.
## Testing
The example unit suite exercises empty input and an ordinary integer; all example assertions pass. This is illustrative evidence, not a recorded test run.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+from src.parser import parse
+
+def test_empty_input():
+    assert parse("") is None
+    assert parse("42") == 42
